cocktail.facto: Gin, vodka and rum. You pick the flavour at the counter, from fourteen.
cocktail.alt: A pale cocktail in a tall glass beside a coconut, on a dark wooden table.

casa.facto: Solid wood, bare granite and a chalkboard. A room in Ermesinde where everyone knows everyone.
casa.alt: Three people laughing around a wooden table with copper mugs, the house name chalked on the wall behind.
casa.alt2: Someone holding the black and gold house menu in front of a granite block wall.

carril.facto: Nine classics, ten specials and five without alcohol. Made at the counter, one at a time.
carril.ilustrativa: The photographs are the house's own. Where the cocktail cannot be identified for certain, the label says only what is known.
carril.fechoNome: And the rest of the list
carril.fechoFacto: Gin, whisky, shots, sangria by the jug, beer, tea and the coffee counter.
carril.balcaoFacto: Lime squeezed by hand over the glass. Every one is made in front of the person drinking it.
carril.balcaoAlt: A hand squeezing half a lime over a tall glass of ice.

sabores.facto: The same ones for the Cocktail Preguiça and for the Unicorn, which is the same glass without the alcohol.

partilhar.facto: Boards of fuet, island cheese and cured ham. Preguiçinhas, which are twenty-four little toasts with chouriço and cheese.
partilhar.alt: A round platter of small toasts, crisps and tabasco, on wood.
partilhar.alt2: A toast with jam beside a hot chocolate topped with cream.

gente.facto: It is what the house calls the people who come. There are also cocktail masterclasses, by sign-up, with counted places.
gente.alt: A person smiling with two copper mugs, in front of the house chalkboard.

recolha.texto: None. This site has no forms, no accounts and stores nothing about its visitors.

terceiros.texto: There are none. Fonts and images are served by this domain, there is no embedded map and no social buttons loading outside code. Links to Google Maps and to social networks are plain links: they are only followed if you click them.

alojamento.texto: The site is hosted by Vercel, which logs server requests in order to serve and protect it. Those logs belong to the platform and are not used by us to identify anyone.

contacto.texto: Reach us through the details on the contact page.

cookies.texto: This site uses no cookies. There are no analytics, advertising or session cookies, and therefore no consent banner — there would be nothing to consent to.
cookies.verificar: You do not have to take our word for it: open your browser's developer tools, Application tab, and see the cookie list for this domain empty.
